Unlike an omitted module section, the invalid supplied enumeration cannot be completed by the MIM.

Backend fixes now reject invalid supplied sharing content, constrain foreign elements to projected schema wildcard contexts/order/cardinality, and attach a typed invalid-FOM boundary. Fresh evidence is D:/workspace/gorti/applicable-fixes-20261004/java/backend-final-java/ and backend-packages-configured-final.jsonl. Remaining lexical, structural, namespace, foreign-schema validation, identity-constraint and merged-FDD cases remain open; this bounded projection is not a complete schema validator.

Initial/corrected runs used a missing-dimensions negative fixture. That inference is withdrawn: 4.5 PDF 52 assesses supplied modules together with the MIM, so an omitted module section is not itself a proven invalid combined FDD. Those raw failures are retained as superseded test-design evidence, not product defects.
